_doc:
Layoff-page distribution without ads or data buying: reach the workers through the two parties who already
hand them paperwork - the employer's HR/outplacement team and the local CareerSource Rapid Response team.
Both are businesses/agencies (B2B), contacted only after Bubba approves. Writes config/outreach.json.
Each item: who, why now (window dates), exact message, the employer-specific page with tracked UTMs.
Run: python research/build_outreach.py

items.target: Magic Leap HR / People team (exit-packet resource)
items.how_to_find: WARN notice lists the company contact; else the company's HR/careers contact or LinkedIn People/HR lead. Business contact only.
items.hypothesis: HR includes our page in exit packets -> affected workers visit -> some request a licensed agent. UNTESTED.
items.pass_if: within 21 days of sending: >= 25 real visits from this link and >= 1 consented lead
